resourceName: Gansu Wuwei Liangzhou Grouped AWMS GHG Mitigation Project
description:
Gansu Wuwei Liangzhou Grouped AWMS GHG Mitigation Project (hereinafter referred to as the grouped project) is a grouped project which installs two new animal waste management systems (AWMSs) to treat the manure from two existing swine farms in Wuwei, Gansu Province. The project is owned and implemented by the subsidiary of Muyuan Foods Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the project proponent). Each swine farm installs one set of AWMS to treat the manure on site. The purpose of the project activity is to treat the manure and wastewater to avoid methane emissions generated in the baseline uncovered anaerobic lagoons.
The grouped project is to install AWMS for each subsidiary swine farm and treat the manure generated on site. Each project activity instance under the grouped project will involve the collection and utilization of the biogas generated from AWMS for energy generation, the part of biogas that cannot be utilized will be destructed by flaring.

values.value: Livestock, enteric fermentation, and manure management
